description: AI-generated charts and maps for Power BI — over 100 chart types, no code, no prompt-writing. Drag in your fields as they are and click Generate — you get a polished, interactive chart that fits your data. Keep it, or refine it in plain language: "make it a heatmap," "add a trend line." Or pick a type yourself, including charts native Power BI visuals can't draw. Often good on the first try — because it knows what every chart needs. With a general-purpose AI, you reword the prompt until something works, then fix the code it wrote. Here, a chart ontology knows what each chart type needs — a date, a hierarchy, a pair of measures, room in the tile. Your fields are matched against it before anything is generated, and each chart is checked and repaired before you see it. Ask for one your fields can't support and the visual says why, then draws the closest fit. Charts that make sense — and some you'd never have thought to try. Click Generate and the visual ranks the chart types that suit your fields, best fit first — free until you pick. Right behind the sensible ones are charts you wouldn't have found: that sales table might make a sharper bump chart, Sankey or map. Small interactive apps, drawn as charts. What-if projections and scenarios with sliders on the chart. New: Cutoff tuner (preview) — drag a threshold along a model score and watch what each cutoff catches, misses and…
keywords: LLM AI Charts and Maps for Power BI
